text: Students, if the poor work for you, don't cheat on their wages, but pay them right away.
Don't disappoint the hungry or upset the needy.
And if they are upset already, don't make things worse by being slow in giving them what they need.
When people ask for help, don't turn them down; and if others are in need, don't turn away.
If you pretend not to notice, they will have good reason to curse you.
And if their curses flow from hearts you made bitter, God, the Creator, will hear them and do what they ask.
Be friendly to everyone in the community and show proper respect to the town leaders.
When the poor greet you, be polite and greet them in return.
Rescue everyone who suffers from injustice; have the courage to make the right decisions;
provide for orphans and widows, as if they were your own children or wife. Then you will be a true child of God Most High, and he will love you more than your own mother does.
If you study Wisdom, you will become her child, and she will help you be successful.
If you love life and want to find happiness, love Wisdom enough to get up early and study.
Hold tightly to her— you will receive glory, and the Lord will bless everyone around you.
To obey her is to worship the Holy Lord God, and if you love Wisdom, the Lord will love you.
Pay attention and obey Wisdom; you will live in safety and even rule nations.
Remain faithful to her, and she will belong to you and your descendants.
At first, Wisdom will test you with her commands, and you will walk in fear along twisting pathways. Her discipline will bring suffering until you are truly faithful.
But then she will return straight to you, bringing happiness and telling her secrets.
But if you wander away, she will let you go off to your doom.
Be on your guard against evil, but use every opportunity for doing good. And don't be ashamed of who you are.
To be ashamed of your sins leads to forgiveness and honor, but some other kinds of shame are sins themselves.
If you play favorites or let bullies push you around, you will get hurt.
If you can make things right by speaking up, then do so. Don't let the opinions of others make you hide your wisdom.[13]
If your wisdom and knowledge are to make any difference, you will have to speak.
Don't ever try to make the truth seem false, but always be humble about things you don't know.
Don't try to hide your sins from God— it would be easier to stop a river from flowing.
Never promise to obey a fool, and don't play favorites while a ruler is watching.
And even if you risk your life fighting for truth, the Lord God will be there, fighting by your side.
Don't be arrogant in what you say, or slow and weak in what you do.
When you are at home, don't be fierce as a lion or suspicious of servants.
Don't hold out your hand when it's time to receive, then close your fist when it's time to give.
